lines.trans: Sister Xingzi, what are you doing here?
The backup plan fell through too!
Sister Xingzi, it was my fault — I need to apologise.
Apologise? Apologise for what?
Ji Xiu saw it — it must have been me who leaked the news.
I ruined the whole thing — what should I do?
Do not cry — rest easy!
We are already taping; all that worry is unnecessary.
Right now? Is the revival round not supposed to tape tomorrow?
